title: COHORTS UNDERWATER
style:
[Intro – female vocoder, distant]
Who’s still here?
Who’s still holding?

[Verse 1 – male]
Under the line where hope feels thin,
There’s a cohort grinding their teeth within.
Coins bought high, now sunk in red,
Timeline full of “told you,” living in their head.
Tom pulls the chart on time underwater,
Shows the curve of patience, each silent holder.
Not just a stat, it’s a human scar,
Months in the dark wondering where you are.

[Pre-Hook – robotic voice]
Percent in profit: falling.
Percent in pain: rising.
Capitulation: pending.

[Hook – male + vocoder]
Cohorts underwater, breathing in fear,
How long can they stay before they disappear?
Bottoms aren’t born in a single tweet,
They form when exhaustion and time finally meet.

[Verse 2 – male]
He traces the exits, the rage quits, the fold,
The ones who swore never, but still got sold.
Not to mock, but to mark the zone,
Where future conviction was quietly grown.
Because someone else steps in when stress is peak,
Long-term mind buying what
lyrics:
[Intro – female vocoder, soft]
Top, bottom, middle of the line.
Not a feeling.
A structure.

[Verse 1 – male]
Everyone wants the story of the final wick,
The one candle low where you “should’ve clicked.”
But Tom doesn’t sell that fairy-tale frame,
He tracks how long we suffer under cost in this game.
Days below basis, teeth clenched tight,
That’s not just price, that’s existential fright.
He maps the span, the depth, the strain,
When cohorts crack and release their pain.

[Hook – layered voices]
Is this a floor, or just a ledge?
Is that a ceiling, or one more edge?
Cycles aren’t magic, they’re stress and time,
Measure the pressure, don’t just guess the line.
When will it flip from dread to belief?
Watch where the chain starts granting relief.

[Verse 2 – male]
Composite risk bands breathing in and out,
Expanding at euphoria, compressing at doubt.
Everyone asks, “Is the bull over yet?”
He points to regimes, not a roulette bet.
From halving to blow-off, from boredom to fear,
He marks the windows where edges appear.
No promise of timing to the very last bar,
Just a range where you shouldn’t be blind in the car.

[Bridge – spoken, minimal beat]
If your plan breaks
every time price moves,
you don’t have a plan.
You have a feeling.

[Final Hook – group, restrained]
Floor or ceiling, stress or release,
Cycles of chaos searching for peace.
Data will show you where risk realigns,
If you’re patient enough to read On-Chain Mind.

3. “TEACH YOU HOW TO FISH”
Vibe: More didactic, almost podcast‑rap hybrid, slightly faster BPM.

[Intro – female vocoder]
No signals.
No “buy now” alarms.
Just charts,
and how to use them.

[Verse 1 – male]
He could’ve gone full guru with a flashing call,
Screenshots flexing every little rise and fall.
Instead he built a suite that’s more like school,
Where the syllabus is: learn your own rule.
He breaks down cost bases, holders by age,
Flows in and out of each exchange.
Not “I’m right,” but “here’s what I see,”
You still pull the trigger, you still ride the sea.

[Hook – chanted, simple]
He won’t tell you “all in, this is it,”
He’ll show you regimes and let you commit.
Not just trades, but a thinking switch,
On-Chain Mind’s here to teach you how to fish.

[Verse 2 – male]
From long-haul cockpit to Bitcoin charts,
Same discipline, different moving parts.
Manage the downside, respect the unknown,
Know where you’re wrong before you’ve flown.
Risk bands glowing like runway lights,
Guiding you through these macro nights.
But the choice to land or circle the sky,
That’s still on you, that’s still your why.

[Bridge – spoken word, nearly acapella]
If you outsource conviction,
you rent your belief.
When the drawdown hits,
the rent comes due.

[Hook – repeat, with harmonies]
He won’t tell you “all in, this is it,”
He’ll show you regimes and let you commit.
Not just trades, but a thinking switch,
On-Chain Mind’s here to teach you how to fish.
